members.subtitle: Every account in this workspace. You create them here, hand over a one-time code in person, and the member chooses their own password.
members.addHint: Pick a username the person will recognise. Creating the account mints a one-time code that is shown once, on this screen, and never again.
members.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. 3–32 characters, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
members.displayNameHint: Optional. Left blank, the username is used.
members.inviteWarning: This is the only time this code is readable. Read it out or write it down now — the server keeps no copy, so there is no way to show it again. If it is lost, issue a new one.
members.reissueBody: ⁨{name}⁩'s current code stops working immediately and a new one is shown once. This is also how a password reset works — a username account has no email to send one to.
members.deleteBody: ⁨{name}⁩ loses access immediately. Their entries stay, credited to their name. Their updates and meeting notes stay too, but without their name on them.
members.promoteBody: ⁨{name}⁩ will be able to edit tracks and vocabulary, and to add and remove members — including you.
members.demoteBody: ⁨{name}⁩ keeps their account and their work, and loses the admin screens.
members.rolesUnavailable: Roles can't be read on this project yet, so each person can only be an admin or a member here. Once Settings › Roles lists your roles, this screen offers them.
members.errUsernameInvalid: Use 3–32 lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
members.errEmailTaken: An account already exists for that address.
members.errNameRequired: A display name is required for an email account.
members.errNotFound: That account no longer exists. Reload the list.
members.errEmailAccount: That account signs in by email code, so it has no invite to reissue.
members.errSelfDelete: You can't delete your own account.
members.errSelfDemote: You can't remove your own admin role.
members.errLastAdmin: This is the last admin. Promote someone else first.
members.errLastAdminMove: This is the only person who can administer the workspace. Move them out of this role and nobody is left to move them back — not you, not anyone — and it could only be repaired from the database itself. Give someone else an administering role first.
members.errRoleReverted: The database kept the role they had. You can't give anyone a permission you don't hold yourself.
members.errNoProfileRow: This account has no profile row yet, so there is nothing to hold a role. Remove it and create it again.
members.errBootstrapAdmin: The workspace owner is always an admin and can't be removed here.
members.errNoPepper: The invite secret isn't configured on this project, so codes can't be issued. See RUNBOOK 4.1.
members.errNetwork: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
members.errCopy: Couldn't reach the clipboard. Read the code off the screen before you dismiss it.
